effects.printed_clause: Banish 2 hand cards including this; add "Bauy World", then optionally draw 1; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Hand ignition banishes this and one other hand card as cost, searches exact Field Spell code, then optionally draws after successful add; id HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Hand cost, exact-card search, and optional follow-up draw structure.

effects.printed_clause: If controlling "Bauy World": Quick Special Summon this banished card, then optionally on your turn banish a GY "Bau", or on opponent turn immediately Synchro Summon; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Banished free-chain effect checks Field Spell, summons self, branches on turn player, and either optionally removes a GY archetype card or calls Duel.SynchroSummon on a currently summonable Extra Deck monster; separate HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Immediate Extra Deck Summon after an effect resolves.

coverage_override.reason: The hand banish/search/optional-draw sequence is one effect. The banished-card Quick Summon and its turn-player-dependent optional bullet follow-up are one second effect; both records include their HOPTs.
